name: Candice Barrau
source:
Candice is Riley's friend. She's in the same class as Riley. She is obsessed with her website project (yukayukafever.com) which Riley is helping her to make. This is also her end of the year project for the computer club.
Candice may be girly, childish and all that kind of stuff... but she has a kind heart and cares a lot about her friends.
It seems Candice has a younger sister who goes to the same school but is in a different class, her name is unknown.
Candice can be found in the crafts room.
